items.title: Germany’s far-right AfD eyes historic first in state election
items.summary: Germany’s far-right AfD is projected to take power in one of the country’s 16 states for the first time.

items.title: Russia’s Putin meets US envoys to discuss Trump proposal to end Ukraine war
items.summary: Both Russia and Ukraine vow not to strike each other's capitals for three days during talks in Moscow and Kyiv.

items.title: Ancient cave art discovery suggests first known humans in Ireland walked over from Wales
items.summary: During the most recent Ice Age, researchers believe there was a "lost land bridge" between Wales and Ireland.

items.title: Croatia: Toxic waste protest draws tens of thousands
items.summary: The Zagreb demonstrators demanded that the government come up with a plan to clear illegal toxic waste in 20 days. Prime Minister Plenkovic has promised to tackle the issue.
